leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement Vue's built-in utility types to define component props with strict type checking
Apply the PropType utility to enforce runtime prop validation in composition API components
Construct reactive state objects using TypeScript utility types like Partial and Readonly
Configure component event emissions with typed event payloads using custom utility types
Manipulate component prop interfaces using utility types for optional and required transformations
Integrate utility types with Vue's ref and reactive functions to maintain type safety
Initialize computed properties with explicit return types using TypeScript's ReturnType utility
